info.title: Mysoleas API
info.description: New Mysoleas architecture: business gateway, Mysoleas Identity Cloud, and SoleasPay ecosystem.

get.description: Returns OAuth endpoints, supported grants, scopes, and the JWKS key.
Redirects the user to Mysoleas Identity Cloud for OAuth2/OIDC authentication with PKCE. The OAuth2 application must be created and configured beforehand in the https://mysoleas.com dashboard.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: URL de retour autorisee pour l'application.

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: Use `code` for the authorization code flow.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scopes demandes, par exemple `openid profile email payments`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Valeur aleatoire que votre application verifie au retour.

parameters.name: code_challenge
parameters.description: Challenge PKCE genere par votre application.

302.description: Redirection vers `redirect_uri` avec un `code` OAuth2 ou une erreur.

post.description: Supports `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, and `refresh_token`. The JWT can be used to open a session in your application, read `userinfo`, or call the gateway with `x-sp-auth-token`.

post.summary: Create and execute a plugin collection

post.description: Validates a mobile number through the public gateway, detects its country when the international format allows it, and returns the national wallet expected by SoleasPay providers.

wallet.description: Customer phone number or wallet to verify.

country.description: Expected country in ISO alpha-3, for example `CMR`. Required for a national number or a calling code pasted without `+` or `00`.

400.description: Invalid number, missing country, or inconsistent country.
